title: refactor(ci): modernize build matrix, cache strategy, and release workflow hygiene
author: Priya Desai
description: Motivation: our GitHub Actions matrices had grown redundant across language/runtime variants and were causing long queue times and noisy cache misses. This PR consolidates similar build matrices, replaces per-job ephemeral caches with a layered restore/save strategy, and modernizes the release workflow steps to reduce duplication and make release automation easier to maintain. Changes: consolidated Node/python build matrices (reduce matrix rows ~40%), introduced a cross-job cache key pattern (repo+hashes+tool-version) to improve cache hit rate, removed deprecated actions and replaced with maintained action v3+ versions, and simplified release workflow to use a single reusable workflow for publish and changelog generation. Checklist: - [x] run full monorepo pipeline locally and in CI - [x] validate Node and Python build matrices produce identical artifacts - [x] verify cache hit improvements across 3 CI runs - [x] update developer docs with new workflow usage - [x] get approvals from infra and platform owners. Testing: measured ~28% median reduction in total CI time on main for lint+unit+integration subset; cache hit-rate improved from ~55% to ~84% on repeated runs. Rollout plan: land on main, monitor next 48h CI metrics (queue time, median run time, cache hit), revert path documented. Notes: no runtime or production code changes; infra-only PR.
